description: This file contains functions and types for handling Slack media, including URL validation, media fetching with authentication, media processing, and thread message retrieval within a Slack monitoring extension.

methods.name: isSlackHostname
methods.description: Checks if a hostname is a recognized Slack CDN hostname.

methods.name: assertSlackFileUrl
methods.description: Validates that a URL is a proper Slack file URL with HTTPS protocol and correct hostname.

methods.name: createSlackMediaFetch
methods.description: Creates a fetch function that adds Slack token authorization for the first request and handles redirects.

methods.name: fetchWithSlackAuth
methods.description: Fetches a URL with Slack authorization, handling redirects to CDN URLs without credentials.

methods.name: resolveSlackMediaMimetype
methods.description: Overrides MIME type for Slack audio files served as video MIME types.

methods.name: looksLikeHtmlBuffer
methods.description: Detects if a buffer appears to contain HTML content.

methods.name: resolveSlackMedia
methods.description: Downloads Slack files attached to a message, returning media info or null.

methods.name: resolveSlackAttachmentContent
methods.description: Extracts text and media from forwarded Slack message attachments.

methods.name: evictThreadStarterCache
methods.description: Removes expired or excess entries from the thread starter cache.

methods.name: resolveSlackThreadStarter
methods.description: Retrieves the original message that started a Slack thread, with caching.

methods.name: resolveSlackThreadHistory
methods.description: Fetches recent messages in a Slack thread for context, with pagination and filtering.
